title: Extract a shared TestWebApplicationFactory helper for integration tests
description:
Seven test files each carry a private CreateFactory(...) that duplicates the same WebApplicationFactory<Program> configuration (temp DataPath/EventLogPath, Maintenance:Enabled=false, isolated SQLite connection string, DataProtectionKeysPath, audit/history paths, admin bootstrap via /api/admin/setup, admin login helper). Drift between copies has already caused test-only auth bugs (see the Auth:AnonymousAccess=Editor incident fixed in 8c30efb2).

### Approach
- Add MemorySmith.Tests/TestHost/MemorySmithTestFactory.cs: static Create(string memoryPath, IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string?>? overrides = null, bool bootstrapAdmin = true)
- Include CreateAdminClientAsync(factory) (login as the bootstrapped admin; cookie carried automatically)
- Migrate the seven call sites file-by-file; keep per-file overrides as the overrides dictionary

### Acceptance criteria
- All existing integration tests pass unchanged
- A single source of truth for test-host configuration; no per-file CreateFactory copies remain
- Bootstrapped admin credentials defined exactly once
